cisplatin.title: Cisplatin (Pt-based)
cisplatin.description: Cisplatin is a prominent chemotherapy drug used to treat various types of cancers. It features a platinum atom bonded to two chloride ions and two ammonia molecules.

cisplatin_dna.title: Cisplatin-DNA Binding
cisplatin_dna.description: Cisplatin binds to DNA, creating cross-links (mostly intra-strand) that bend the DNA helix. This structural distortion blocks replication and transcription, ultimately leading to cancer cell death.

oxaliplatin.title: Oxaliplatin (Advanced Pt-drug)
oxaliplatin.description: Oxaliplatin is a third-generation platinum-based chemotherapy. It features a bulky DACH ligand, making it effective against certain cisplatin-resistant cancers, particularly colorectal cancer.

oxaliplatin_dna.title: Oxaliplatin-DNA Adduct
oxaliplatin_dna.description: Oxaliplatin forms bulky DNA adducts that are less easily recognized by cellular repair mechanisms compared to cisplatin. The resulting DNA damage triggers apoptosis.
